caption.text:
Grief comes in waves… and sometimes it hits me so hard that he never got to meet my babies, and that they never got to know him. 💔

Follow @hereverydaymotherhood for more relatable motherhood + marriage moments 🤍

communication_seed.first_comment: Same with my grandpa. He passed from cancer right before bryan left for basic training. He knew bryan and i got engaged but didnt get to see us get married or get to meet his great grandsons. 😞  Grandpa Kovalik would have loved your little man with his entire heart! I can see him now holding him tightly crying with how much love he has for him. He is up in heaven looking down so proud of you and the mom you have become! 💕

This one has me all emotional with the sad feels. My dad died before he was able to meet my daughter’s babies and it breaks my heart. I know he is with us, but boy I would have loved to see them go play in the woods together, do a little fishing, and ride some 4 wheelers on back country trails for hours on end. Greatly missed, but never forgotten.  I have to believe he was needed in heaven to protect us here on earth. 🌍 🩵🤍💙

Oh this made me emotional 💔 my  great grandad died when I was young ( around 12 ) but the impact he had on my life I still carry with me today - he knew he wouldn’t be there but left money to pay for my wedding and a help in starting my life what ever that may have been our son is named after him and daughter after the great nan who I never met but he spoke about her being the love of his life❤️ I’m 40 now and miss him and talk about him to my children I know it would have never been so possible

@nkovalik88 we know Grandpa would have loved being able to see all of his great grandchildren. God had different plans though. Even better is knowing they will be able to spend eternity in heaven with him! That’s going to be FOREVER!
